status: SEALED_WHEN_COMMITTED (stage 1); every later stage cites this file's sha256
whyAmended: The 2026-11 B2 evidence used observations that were not public at the information cutoff (H.10 FX released on the following Monday, H.15 rates released the next business day 16:15 ET, and for KR the US closes of the cutoff date itself). See audits/2026-11-pit-review.json.
inheritsFromV1: b2Output fields and forbidden numeric claims

availability.rule: an observation enters the evidence packet only if its release time is at or before the region's informationCutoffUtc (the regional close of the receipt's asOfDate)

sources.H10: DEXKOUS: Monday 16:15 ET after the observation's week (next business day if a federal holiday); 2006-05-22..2009-01 unverified and excluded
sources.H15: DGS10, DGS3MO, T10YIE: next federal business day 16:15 ET
sources.VIX: VIXCLS: conservative H.15 rule (FRED posting time unverifiable)
sources.FX_VENDOR: Yahoo FX daily bars: excluded (no verifiable close time)

stages.1_SEAL: this protocol is committed unchanged; packet creation refuses an uncommitted or modified protocol
stages.2_PACKET: desk.py packet: first FINAL_WEEKLY receipt of month M per region, PIT-filtered market/macro, gates applied, execution schedule fixed; writes cohorts/M/evidence-packet.json and review-request.json (status AI_REVIEW_REQUIRED). Must be committed before any review
stages.3_REVIEW: each enabled reviewer writes cohorts/M/reviews/<reviewer>.json from the packet alone; a reviewer first commits cohorts/M/commitments/<reviewer>.sha256 (commit-reveal) so independence can be checked from git order
stages.4_DECIDE: desk.py decide: refuses unless packet and every review are committed unchanged and published before the registration deadline; writes B0, B1, B2 (primary reviewer) and BX:<reviewer> comparison records
stages.5_PUBLISH: the ledger lines must reach a public commit before the registration deadline; desk.py verify-publication records a PUBLICATION_VERIFIED annotation from git, never from the record's self-declared time
stages.6_EVALUATE: desk.py evaluate: after each horizon has closed, appends SCORED or SOURCE_BLOCKED outcomes

schedule.plannedExecution: the first regional session whose OPEN is at least reviewWindowHours after the packet's sealedAtUtc; fixed in the packet so every path and arm of the cohort executes on the same close
schedule.registrationDeadline: that execution session's open (UTC); records published later are refused (REGISTRATION_CLOSED)
schedule.missedDeadline: if no review is committed by the deadline the cohort records B0 and B1 only and B2 is NO_REVIEW (never back-filled)

reviewers.comparisonArms: BX:<reviewer> for every ENABLED non-primary reviewer; arms never replace B2 and never promote
reviewers.independence: commit-reveal: all commitments for a cohort precede the first revealed review in git history, else the arm is INDEPENDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED and reported separately
reviewers.noBackfill: a judgment produced after a cohort's registration deadline (for example a stock idea proposed in conversation) is never registered as that cohort's signal

evaluation.prices: Yahoo chart API close (split-adjusted) plus dated cash distributions, frozen with SHA-256 per evaluation run
evaluation.entry: close of plannedExecution (closing auction, the executable reference)
evaluation.exit: close of the 126th / 252nd regional session after entry
evaluation.totalReturn: TR_end / TR_entry - 1 with distributions reinvested at the ex-date close
evaluation.benchmark: the region's ETF (069500.KS / SPY) on the same basis
evaluation.costs: receipt round-trip cost once per leg; 2x stress reported beside
sourceBlocked: a missing regional session close inside the window
a split or consolidation inside the window not listed in verified-corporate-actions.json
a close-to-close move beyond the daily limit (KR 30%, US 50%) without a verified event
no close on the horizon end session (delisting or data end)
evaluation.primaryComparison: records annotated PIT_CONTAMINATED or INDEPENDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED are scored but reported outside the primary B0/B1/B2 comparison
